ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a well‑played San Diego show, highlighted by a smoking Space→Other One sequence.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as a solid, well‑played set that kicked off the new year in San Diego, with the second set standing out—especially the expansive Space>Other One where Phil’s bass shines. Reviewers note this is the best‑sounding copy on the archive, offering clear instrument separation and a notably crisp mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review rates the show 4/5 overall, highlighting strong musical performance and excellent recording quality; limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix with good instrument separation; Phil’s bass is especially audible, indicating a high‑fidelity soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth progression that built momentum into the second set, delivering a powerful Space>Other One segment.

band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for clear presence and 'all over the place' bass work during Space>Other One.
